text.en:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits generates 2 Ammo to Magazine.
Precision Hit counter is reset if no precision hits are scored within 2 seconds.

enhanced (
#e Timer between Precision Hits increased to 3 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
4 次快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里返还 2 枚弹药。
如果 2 秒内没有精准命中，则计数器会被重置。

enhanced (
#e 精准命中可间隔时间延长到 3 秒。
)
